title: The Day Oregon Blew Up a Whale #shorts

lines.text: In nineteen seventy, Oregon tried to get rid of a dead whale by blowing it up with half a ton of dynamite.
An eight ton whale washed up on the beach, and the smell was unbelievable.
The highway engineer had a plan. "Blow it into little pieces, and the seagulls will eat them."
A guy in the crowd who knew explosives took one look and said, "That's way too much."
Nobody listened. He'd just bought a brand new car at a sale called, no joke, Whale of a Deal.
Giant chunks of blubber flew over the crowd, and people ran while whale rained from the sky.
One huge chunk landed right on that brand new car and smashed the roof.
You see, a blast pushes stuff whichever way is easiest, and with sand underneath, the easiest way was up.
It's like stomping on a ketchup packet. You don't get rid of it, you just put it everywhere.
Most of the whale was still lying on the beach, and the seagulls wouldn't even come near it.
The engineer called the whole thing a success.
Six months later, he got a promotion.
